notes.title: Second patch has arrived
notes.content:
Dear players, 

our latest BUILD 2.1.10 is up and running.

We have fixed the following:

FIXED CPU debug mini-game
( the ball doesn't pass through brackets and has 30% faster movement speed ) 

We will continue hunting for any possible bugs. If you come across any, feel free to report them on our community hub.

Airo Games Team

notes.title: Life of Delta's patch is live now
notes.content:
Dear players, 

our latest BUILD 2.1.8 is up and running. 

We have fixed the following: 

- FIXED Inventory closes when moving mouse over 8th item
- FIXED Delta walks through the air when selecting the button/hook while standing on the box
- FIXED Wires won't pop in the Chip mini-game if a certain combination is tried first
- FIXED Magnetic crane created a steel beam copy in a certain move combination
- FIXED Gear mini-game contains lock-on points for gears on top of existing gears
- FIXED Sleeping pills are not collectable after getting sushi orders from the guards
- FIXED Stun gun prompt is re-enabled after returning to the elevator room
- FIXED Player gets stuck if he goes to menu straight after talking to the Mechanic
- FIXED Window cleaning animation glitch causes player to get stuck in the laser puzzle
- FIXED Music mini-game has a slight delay in visuals
- FIXED 'Friend in need' and 'Prison escape' steam achievements can be accidentally skipped
- FIXED Push crate prompt in LVL-9 is still clickable after initial use

We will continue hunting for any possible bugs. If you come across any, feel free to report them on our community hub. 

Airo Games Team
